text:
Nina Torres: Idea
We need a lightweight remediation card attached to each postmortem + a weekly triage radar that surfaces: overdue items, 2nd-occurrence flags, and blocked remediations.

Nina Torres: Card fields suggestion:
Owner / Backup / Priority / ETA (7d/30d/90d) / Ack SLA (48h) / Verification steps / Done criteria / Rollback plan / Observability changes / Blocked-by / Recurrence flag / Status

Ibrahim Khan: +1. add a small "impact re-check" at verification to confirm customer-facing metrics recovered. also suggest automatic overdue reminders at 7d and 30d.

Samira Patel: For verification let's require: smoke test, canary window, and dashboard panel update. i'll draft a 5-item testing checklist we can paste into the card.

Drew Morgan: Rotation note: propose 5-week IC rotations with a 4-day shadow/handoff window. shadow week to include a pairing on the last high-severity incident runbook.

Nina Torres: On recurrence detection - how about escalation at 2 repeats in 60 days (auto-escalate to platform lead) and 3 repeats in 90 days triggers a dedicated RCA sprint?

Ibrahim Khan: I can add a small tracker query to tag repeats and surface them in the weekly radar widget. Will also wire the 7/30 reminder webhooks.

Samira Patel: volunteers: i'll create the verification checklist + copy of the remediation card template. will include examples for observability changes (alert thresholds + dashboard links).

Drew Morgan: i'll own the IC rotation calendar and handoff checklist (access, runbooks, recent incidents, open remediations, pairing schedule).

playbook-bot: Created playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/remediation-radar-v0 (edit access: eng-oncall)

ops-bot: Poll posted: "Playbook review cadence" (options: weekly / biweekly). please vote.

Nina Torres: Plan: Samira (card + checklist), Ibrahim (recurrence + reminders), Drew (rotation schedule). i'll combine and we pilot the radar next week. Thanks folks :rocket:
